annotations.title: Best final price for a product

description: Find a product (by words such as "dyson v8 vacuum", or by its GTIN/UPC/EAN) in the US stores' own product feeds and get, for each store that sells it, the price, the codes and sales that apply to it, and the final price after the best code. Every promotion says whether it applies (certain | likely | basket = needs a bigger basket | may_apply = vague terms) and why. A final price after a code is given only when the terms clearly cover this item at this price; otherwise the listed price is the final price. Every number carries its evidence: which feed it came from, when the catalog was built, and whether the price was checked on the store page. Same product across stores is matched by GTIN, then brand + MPN or model number, never by a similar name. US stores and USD only for now. Use it when the user wants a specific product cheaply, sets a budget, or asks you to check for discounts on an item.

country.description: Optional ISO country code. Only US is covered for now.

gtin.description: Optional barcode number (UPC, EAN or GTIN) instead of words.

max_price.description: Optional budget in USD: only products whose final price is at or under it.

query.description: What the user wants, in a few words (brand, product, model).

name: find_best_price
title: Best final price for a product
